title: Curation reel floor + failure resilience; Debrief legibility and honest empty states

test.evidence: 49 tests across curation-core, curation-e2e, video-tighten, evidence-retention, results-e2e, ux-e2e

liveProof.evidence: replayed real run 01KY4DREZ1VD3Z1JT59P0PKZP0 spotter frames: chunk coverage 8/36 -> 36/36 under the new fair allocation (budget 30 -> 72 for 36 checks); applyReelFloor with ZERO model verdicts still yields 36/36 chunks covered

notes: Two existing tests were updated, not weakened: curationConfig gained maxCuratedExplicit, and the reel is no longer a strict subset of model keeps because the floor adds frames. Both now assert the stronger guarantee (every chunk covered; floored frames flagged and annotated).
